newsitem.title: USA: Giant Eagle to acquire Riser Foods for $403 million.
newsitem.headline: Giant Eagle to acquire Riser Foods for $403 million.

text.p: Riser Foods Inc. said Wednesday it agreed to be acquired by Giant Eagle Inc., a privately held retail supermarket chain and wholesale distributor, for $403 million.
The combined company will have supermarkets in Ohio, Pennsylvania and West Virginia, and wholesale operations in both Pennsylvania and Ohio, with sales of about $4 billion in 1998.
Riser said Giant Eagle will acquire all its outstanding class A and B stock for $42 per share, assume about $47 million of debt and acquire existing options.
Riser's stock rose 75 cents to $41.625 early on the American Stock Exchange.

Giant Eagle will begin a tender offer for all of Riser's class A stock outstanding and is expected to complete the transaction in June. It will acquire all the outstanding class B stock after the deal closes, the companies said.
David Shapira will remain chairman and chief executive of Giant Eagle.
Anthony Rego, chairman and chief executive of Riser, has been named vice chairman of Giant Eagle, in addition to his role as chief executive of Riser Foods.
Riser, based in Bedford Heights, Ohio, said the deal will be financed under a firm commitment that Giant Eagle has received from a major U.S. bank.
Riser said two weeks ago it was in talks to be acquired by a supermarket chain that it did not identify.
